verdict.rationale: Figma ships an official MCP server (confirmed live via runtime probe) that extracts variables, components, and layout data into the IDE, generates code from frames, and Code Connect maps design components to real codebase code; REST API also allows extracting objects/layers and properties. This directly covers the story's frames/variables/component-mapping needs for coding agents. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of screenshot extraction via MCP (only implied through live-UI capture) and independent hands-on user reports specifically validating MCP-based design-context pulls (community evidence cited predates/doesn't address MCP usage).
